speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, I bought Shawna a house before I bought myself another shirt.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The real estate woman met us at Lake Las Vegas and immediately lost one heel to the lawn. Tank reached down, pulled it free, and handed it back. She looked at his hands, our cars, and the bandage under my collar.

speaker: B01C04_REAL_ESTATE_AGENT
text: "Will anybody else be joining the viewing?"

speaker: B01C04_REAL_ESTATE_AGENT
text: "Five bedrooms. Private dock. Heated pool. The piano can be negotiated separately."

speaker: B01C04_REAL_ESTATE_AGENT
text: "The owner may wish to retain it."

speaker: TANK
text: "Tell that nigga to wish for a smaller instrument."

speaker: AIDEN
text: The woman got both shoes onto stone and opened the door.

speaker: AIDEN
text: White curtains, high ceilings, a curved staircase. Enough chandelier to make a nigga nervous about standing under the light. Beyond the glass doors was the lake. The black piano sat beside them, where Shawna could look at the water while she played.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She let go of my hand.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She touched two keys without pressing them.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, we have a yes. Do whatever paper follows yes."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Don't say it louder than she said yes."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank walked out onto the dock. Shawna sat at the piano. I lowered myself beside her and got halfway through pretending it didn't hurt before she caught my arm.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "That IS slowly. At my normal speed we'd own next door already."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She laughed, then looked at the lake again.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She put one leg over the bench and faced me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: My smile stayed a second longer than it belonged. Through the window, Tank was testing the dock with one shoe. A duck watched him. Neither nigga trusted the other's business there.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She put her hand on my knee.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I let her keep it there. Nigga, I could sit through that much truth if she kept touching me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The woman returned with the price. I sent her to the men handling T's accounts. The club and its money had survived him. His house was promised elsewhere. This house would carry Shawna's name.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna said before I could answer.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Put the keys in her hand. Piano stays. My wife said—"

speaker: AIDEN
text: She kissed me hard enough that I had to grip the bench. Behind the glass, Tank finally stepped onto the dock and the duck left.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Two niggas had secured waterfront property. I liked my method better.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Rosa came over that evening and stood in the foyer without taking off her sunglasses. My nigga, she looked at that chandelier like it owed her money.

speaker: ROSA
text: "Nigga, this bitch gets shot at one time and comes home with a staircase."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna screamed laughing. I hadn't heard her do that before. Not the little laugh she'd given me in the car. This came from deep enough to make me realize how much of her I hadn't met.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The nigga looked at me like he wanted permission to leave. I couldn't stop smiling.

speaker: AIDEN
text: They went up together. Within an hour Rosa had decided which room belonged to her, which bathroom had the best light, and which of the dead owner's paintings was making everybody sad. It wasn't a dead owner. He had moved to Arizona. She took the painting down anyway.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I sat in the living room with my nigga Tank and an ice pack wrapped in a towel, listening to women take over my fucking palace.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked at him. He kept his eyes on the stairs.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I threw the ice pack at him. He caught it without standing.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, I got a bullet in me. You want me jumping up to fight your big ass?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Then stop saying shit I can't sit down for."

speaker: AIDEN
text: He put the ice pack back on my side. Gently, which pissed me off worse.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Upstairs, Shawna laughed again. We both looked toward the sound.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The first housewarming party started before anybody found the towels.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Mercedes arrived with twelve women, two men, and a box of champagne she swore had been a gift. Porsche arrived behind her driving a white Bentley with the roof down and a man crying in the back seat.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, blink if she bought you too,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: He laughed so hard he stopped crying. Thirty-seven, name of Leon, owned a steakhouse and had apparently proposed to Porsche over appetizers. She had declined the ring and accepted permission to drive.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Mercedes told him as she took a bottle from his lap.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Within twenty minutes the patio filled. My new pool had women in it wearing diamonds that probably hadn't been designed for swimming. A dealer I knew was trying to impress Rosa with the size of his watch. Rosa held it up to her ear and told him she couldn't hear the personality inside it.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The nigga looked at Tank's shoulders and decided he'd enjoyed it too.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I lay back in a chair with Shawna beside me and a clean shirt open over my bandages. People kept bringing gifts. Liquor. Flowers. A statue of a horse nobody could explain. Somebody had brought a whole refrigerated truck of steaks because he'd heard Aiden had a yard now and wanted Aiden to know that meant something to him.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked across the water. Lights stood on the other shore. The moon caught the edge of her watch.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She pointed at the horse statue.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Before I could, a red speedboat came around the point and headed straight for our dock.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The driver stood at the wheel. He had a white shirt open to the waist and a chain thick enough to anchor the boat if his ego failed. Two men sat behind him holding rifles across their knees.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The music kept going. Half the people hadn't heard him. The boat struck the dock hard enough to lift the planks, and now everybody heard.

speaker: AIDEN
text: the man at the wheel shouted.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "He looked old enough to make that decision."

speaker: ROMAN_PIKE
text: "Brock had no right selling my house."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Then look at me while you regret that."

speaker: AIDEN
text: His eyes found mine. Behind him, one of his men shifted the rifle.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The music ended between songs. For half a second the whole party went quiet. Even the women in the pool stopped splashing, holding on to the edge with their jeweled hands.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "You can go around. My dock's occupied."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, so does my insurance company. You just hit the fucking dock."

speaker: AIDEN
text: He stepped out of the boat. Forty-two, I found out later. Old enough to own three houses and stupid enough to think the one with me in it would be easiest to take.

speaker: ROMAN_PIKE
text: "I come for twenty thousand a month,"

speaker: ROMAN_PIKE
text: "My cousin paid. You pay. We don't have trouble."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga sold his house and left a subscription."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She laughed into her hand. Roman's face got dark.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank moved. So did Roman's men. Shots broke the silence and the patio doors exploded behind me. I dropped off the chair with Shawna in my arms. We hit the stone hard. The pain made my vision go white, but I kept her under me until the next shots passed.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Mercedes pulled two women from the pool and pushed them through the kitchen door. Porsche caught Leon by his collar and dragged him behind the Bentley.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Rosa rolled across the patio with my gun in her hand. She'd taken it off the table when everybody else was looking at Roman. She slid it to me without getting up.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Roman ran back toward the boat while his men fired from the dock. Tank answered from behind the stone barbecue, rounds striking wood around their feet. A bottle burst above him and drenched his suit in champagne.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked at the white Bentley.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The car stood at the end of the patio drive. Between it and the dock lay fifty feet of lawn, two chairs, and a stone garden border that suddenly looked like a promise.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She kissed me so hard I forgot the pain for exactly as long as the kiss lasted.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I ran for the Bentley bent at the waist. Porsche opened the driver's door before I got there. Leon held out both hands as if he could personally catch whatever was about to happen to his car.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I got in. Porsche threw herself into the passenger seat.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Roman's boat pulled off the dock. The red hull swung broadside, engine screaming, and I drove the Bentley across my own fucking lawn.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Grass and stone flew behind us. The chairs disappeared under the front bumper. Porsche grabbed the door and shouted,

speaker: AIDEN
text: like she'd been waiting all her life for somebody to drive a hundred thousand dollars through a flowerbed.

speaker: AIDEN
text: We went over the end of the dock and landed across the speedboat's rear deck.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, the sound was enormous. Fiberglass broke. The Bentley's hood folded. The boat pitched forward, bow plunging into the water, and Roman flew over his steering wheel into the lake.

speaker: AIDEN
text: For one second all I could see was white spray.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Then it cleared, and I was sitting in a car on a boat in front of my new house while thirty people screamed my name.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Roman came up beside the boat spitting lake water. His pistol was gone. One of his men had jumped into the shallows. Tank was standing at the end of the broken dock with his gun on the other one.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I leaned out of the Bentley.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He looked up at me with wet hair in his eyes.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Leon stood on the patio with both hands on his head.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The cheering started again. Mercedes climbed onto a chair and lifted a bottle in each hand. Rosa had both arms around Shawna. Tank was laughing so hard he had to tell the prisoner to stop fucking looking at him.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna came to the edge of the ruined dock and held out her hands.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "You are the most ridiculous man I've ever met."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I climbed out of the Bentley and took them.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Nigga, I married a dream tonight and I haven't even married you."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She pulled me close while the boat settled deeper beneath the car. Behind her, Leon announced he'd never loved an automobile more and never wanted to see it again.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Roman went away wet. His men went with Tank until Knox's people came to collect them. The chief called me herself that night.

speaker: GLORIA_KNOX
text: "One. Can you do that in uniform?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked at Shawna curled against me on the sofa, the whole house still alive with our friends, and smiled.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Depends how nice you make the uniform."

speaker: AIDEN
text: The club opened for me the following night.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I wore a white suit because I wanted every nigga there to know I wasn't expecting to bleed. Shawna wore blue silk with her whole back out and earrings so long they touched her shoulders. Rosa had done her hair. I had bought the earrings. Dante's watch was still on her wrist.

speaker: AIDEN
text: We pulled up to blue lights running all the way down the sidewalk. My name was above the door. They had done that without asking. AIDEN in letters taller than the apartment windows I'd grown up behind.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, I stood under it long enough to make the cars behind us honk.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna hooked her arm through mine.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Inside, the whole west side had dressed like it was getting married to money. Women in diamonds. Men in velvet. Champagne sweating in silver tubs. Cocaine on mirrored tables in the private rooms. Hookers I knew from bad months wearing shoes that cost more than those months. Niggas who owed everybody suddenly buying bottles with both hands.

speaker: AIDEN
text: One of the dancers came down from a platform and kissed my cheek.

speaker: B01C04_DANCER
text: "Look at my nigga! Baby, you made it."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I put a stack of cash in her hand. She held it against her chest and went back up laughing.

speaker: AIDEN
text: At the back table, a pretty man in a silver shirt stood up when he saw me. I'd spent a reckless weekend with him the year before, broke and drunk and swearing on his balcony that one day I'd own the view.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He kissed the corner of my mouth before I could turn.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna's arm went stiff through mine.

speaker: AIDEN
text: He looked at her and smiled.

speaker: B01C04_PRETTY_MAN
text: "Keep it, girl. Cost me a weekend's sleep."

speaker: AIDEN
text: We moved on. Shawna waited until we reached our table.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "How many niggas in here have you fucked?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: "You want me counting niggas I only kissed?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: She hit my good shoulder with her purse.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Nigga, I want you sitting your ass down."

speaker: AIDEN
text: I sat. Nigga, I had survived T, but I wasn't trying to survive her in those earrings.

speaker: AIDEN
text: My nigga, she sat sideways on my lap until my face told on me, then moved into the chair beside mine. Her hand stayed on my thigh. Every time some nigga approached the table, she pulled me closer by the collar before letting go.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I loved that shit. I had women flirting with me, men remembering me, the whole room learning which side of her I belonged on. Nigga, let them look. I'd spent my whole life feeling like people could leave me wherever they found me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Rosa stood onstage in the red velvet coat. Under it she wore gold from her throat to the floor.

speaker: ROSA
text: "I ain't said your name yet, bitch."

speaker: AIDEN
text: The room started clapping. Rosa held out her hand.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I meant it. My nigga, I would've bought her an orchestra and scared her right out the back door. Rosa just stood there with a microphone and waited for her friend.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The first few steps looked harder than the walk I'd made out of the hospital. She kept one hand against her stomach. When she reached the stage, Rosa kissed her cheek and gave her the microphone.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, I had heard people say a voice could break your heart. I thought it meant somebody sang pretty while you remembered somebody ugly. Then Shawna opened her mouth and I stopped knowing where I was.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She sang about leaving a porch light burning. About a car going past the house. About getting dressed for somebody who wasn't coming home. Her voice shook on the first line. By the second verse, men stopped pouring drinks. A woman by the bar put her face in her hands.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I watched that watch slide down Shawna's wrist when she lifted the microphone.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, I turned so fast my side lit up.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The nigga was staring at the stage. He hadn't said it to hurt me. That almost made it worse.

speaker: AIDEN
text: All these niggas were listening to my woman sing for her husband while my name glowed outside.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I drank what was in front of me. Then I remembered what Vega had said and put the glass down, furious with myself for needing a fucking doctor in my head while another man had a song.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna opened her eyes during the last verse. She looked straight at me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I couldn't tell which of us she saw.

speaker: AIDEN
text: When she finished, the whole club got up. Niggas banged on tables. Rosa cried openly. I stood too, slow and angry, clapping until my hands hurt.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna came down smiling like a girl who had found something under the bed she thought she'd lost forever.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I kissed her before I answered.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Why you looking at me like that?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Later, a man from one of the cash tables grabbed Rosa by the coat when she told him she was done working.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, I was standing before Tank got to me.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The nigga looked over his shoulder, still holding Rosa. That was his mistake. Not knowing me could've been fixed. Holding on after he saw somebody coming was the part that put him on the floor.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I hit him once. Hard enough that I felt something pull under my bandages. Tank caught my elbow before I could hit him again.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Nigga, whose hand you think that is? Take your fucking hands off her,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: The man wasn't holding anything now.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Rosa pulled her coat straight. Her hands shook. She hated that we could see them.

speaker: AIDEN
text: The room had gone still around us. All these niggas had wanted a new boss to buy champagne. Now they had one bleeding into a white suit because somebody hadn't let go of Shawna's friend.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Tank handed the man to two others and walked me into the back office. Shawna followed. So did Rosa.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She unbuttoned my jacket. A little red had come through the shirt.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Nigga, you don't know another fucking sentence?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: Rosa stood by the door with both hands inside her coat.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She pressed her lips together. Then she came over, bent down, and kissed my head again.

speaker: AIDEN
text: But she stayed beside me until Shawna got a clean shirt.

speaker: AIDEN
text: At home, the lake was black under the windows.

speaker: AIDEN
text: Shawna took off her earrings and laid them on the bathroom counter. I watched her unclasp the watch.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Let me buy you one that fits,"

speaker: AIDEN
text: She turned around. The silence got ugly fast.

speaker: AIDEN
text: I stood in the doorway, tired enough that my legs shook.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She hadn't even tried to soften it. Nigga, I would've taken one little lie right then. Just something I could lay down beside.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "You look at me when you sing to him?"

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "I looked at you because you were there."

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I'm always there. You wearing his watch, my earrings, got his chain on my fucking neck—"

speaker: AIDEN
text: She rubbed where my fingers had been. I hadn't hurt her. I could still see that I'd done something I didn't want between us.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "Nigga, what do you want from me?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I looked down at the marble. I'd bought the whole floor and couldn't find a place to stand.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "I want one thing that's only mine."

speaker: AIDEN
text: She came close and put her palm over my heartbeat, clear of the wound.

speaker: AIDEN
text: "Then why'd you say his name in the hospital?"

speaker: AIDEN
text: I wished I'd kept it. Held it in until it killed me by itself. But it was out now, standing between us in our new fucking bathroom.

speaker: SHAWNA
text: "And I was trying to tell him you were hurt."

speaker: AIDEN
text: Nigga, I didn't know what to do with that.

speaker: AIDEN
text: She took my hand and led me to bed. We didn't settle it. She didn't put the watch away. I didn't take off the cross. She kissed me until I stopped asking questions, and when we lay down, she kept her head on my good side.

speaker: AIDEN
text: For that morning, that was enough.
